The entry bought the premarket top: QCOM's +10% cross came at 09:00 on a 0.9% calm gap after a 168.74 close, and the 09:09 spinning top printed at 185.00 with the day's high 185.26 one bar earlier. The opening auction and first 11 minutes of RTH unwound 6.35% -- a large-cap ($200B) reacting to news is not the coil the C37 rank was fitted on (penny / small-cap gappers), and the 30-bar pressure model had 0.996 coil on 8k-share premarket bars.

No C37 exit mechanism was ever live: the pressure trail needs a +10% excursion from entry (never above +0.2%), the hard stop sat 2.0-2.5% under the entire RTH range, and the 1/3 bank at +25% is unreachable on a large-cap. For a name like this the only working exit is the 14:50 ladder, i.e. hold-to-close by construction.

The halal gate is the binding constraint on capital again: 102 names screened, 73 FAIL (15 LOAN>10+COMBINED>20, 9 CASH>10+COMBINED>20, 21 industry / q2 fails, the rest haram-revenue or mixed), 29 PASS of which three carry crypto caveats (IOND, AGPU, CYPH) and most of the rest are sub-$10 microcaps with 1-2% books. Only $15k of the $100k budget was deployed.

Trigger C polling did not start until 08:03 (error 08:03); two PHVS signals (07:56 macd_cross_up, 07:59 morning_star) aged out unseen and were not credited. A third (08:31 tweezer_bottom) surfaced inside a chained wait (error 08:34) -- the Day-13 / Day-21 loop-ordering defect again, fixed on the spot by gating the wait on the trigger output. The five PHVS signals evaluated live (08:37-08:49) were all refused on spread (1.0-2.4%) and depth, so the miss is a process defect, not a lost fill.

Scan spill handling: from 09:27 every RTH run_scan (166-185 rows, 60-66 KB) exceeded the tool-result cap and spilled to a file; copying the spilled file with python as the dump and running scan_sweep.py on it directly worked every time and kept the raw JSON out of context. The premarket delta/rebuild path (scan_delta.py) is only needed while the scan is small.
